title: The Studio Sprint
lede: One fixed price and one deadline, both in the contract. You pay per finished milestone, so if we run late, you haven't paid for the late part.

pattern.title: One proven approach, repeated
pattern.body: Every build runs on the same spine: web and mobile from one codebase, a managed backend, an AI assistant layer, continuous delivery, and production deployment. Proven on our own products, Bloop and Washiiba, both shipped on this exact spine, not a one-off experiment. Standardized scope protects your timeline and keeps senior attention where it counts. The same spine ships founder MVPs, internal tools, customer portals and ops automation.

audit.summary: Not sure what to build yet? In about a week we review what you have, what it would take to ship, and where AI is worth using. You keep the written report whether or not you build with us.

notFor.title: When we're the right fit
items: You want a working product in production, not a mockup.
You want one studio to own delivery, not extra hands to manage.
You care more about the right outcome and a predictable timeline than the lowest bid.
You see AI as a way to move faster on serious engineering.
You want a partner with opinions on scope and architecture.
notItems: Your scope is still open and you'd rather pay by the hour.
